q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
Let me work through this carefully.

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is 2026-08-17. Q2 FY2027 earnings would typically be released in May 2026 (based on the research showing May 20, 2026 release date for Q1 FY2027). This means Q2 FY2027 guidance was already issued in May 2026, which is ~2.75 months in the past from the current date. 

However, the question asks "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release?" This is asking for the forward guidance number that was already released. The resolution is asking for a historical fact that has already occurred.

**Time to resolution: Already happened (guidance released May 20, 2026)**

This gives a range of $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion. The research also notes this guidance was "significantly above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion" according to LSEG.

The question asks for the forward guidance value itself (not actual results), and this has been publicly disclosed. There is no uncertainty here—it's a known fact.

The point estimate should be centered on $91.0 billion, with the understanding that the company's official range is $89.18B to $92.82B (±2%).

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 Fiscal Year 2027 revenue was released on May 20, 2026, alongside its Q1 FY2027 earnings report. The company expects revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). This guidance is significantly above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). NVIDIA has explicitly stated that its Q2 FY2027 revenue outlook does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

For Q2 FY2027, GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are expected to be 74.9% and 75.0% respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points. GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are anticipated to be approximately $8.5 billion and $8.3 billion, respectively [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/).
